record.original_question: For two-dimensional hydrodynamics on the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms, does the action functional associated with the L2 kinetic-energy metric satisfy the Palais-Smale compactness condition?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed two-dimensional Riemannian manifold (with a fixed volume form), and let $\mathrm{SDiff}(M)$ denote the group of smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphisms of $M$. Equip $\mathrm{SDiff}(M)$ with the right-invariant $L^2$ metric whose value on a divergence-free vector field $u$ tangent to $\mathrm{SDiff}(M)$ at the identity is $\tfrac{1}{2}\int_M |u|^2\, d\mathrm{vol}$. For a smooth path $\eta:[0,1]\to\mathrm{SDiff}(M)$, define the kinetic-energy action functional 
$$ \mathcal{A}(\eta) \;=\; \tfrac{1}{2}\int_0^1 \int_M \bigl|\partial_t \eta(t,x)\bigr|^2\, d\mathrm{vol}(x)\, dt, $$
considered on a suitable space of paths with fixed endpoints in $\mathrm{SDiff}(M)$ (so that critical points correspond to solutions of the incompressible Euler equations on $M$).

Question: Does the functional $\mathcal{A}$ satisfy the Palais–Smale compactness condition? That is, must every sequence $\{\eta_n\}$ of paths along which $\mathcal{A}(\eta_n)$ is bounded and $\|d\mathcal{A}(\eta_n)\|\to 0$ admit a strongly convergent subsequence?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a recent collection of open problems on geometric hydrodynamics (2022). No published resolution of the Palais–Smale property for the 2D $L^2$ hydrodynamic action functional on the volume-preserving diffeomorphism group was found in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Geometric Hydrodynamics in Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 9 asks whether the action functional for the L2 kinetic-energy metric in 2D hydrodynamics satisfies the Palais-Smale condition.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an unresolved open question in a 2022 compilation of open problems in geometric hydrodynamics.

status_evidence.title: Semi-invariant Riemannian metrics in hydrodynamics
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Fredholm properties of the Riemannian exponential map for the L2 metric on volume-preserving diffeomorphisms; 2D exponential map is Fredholm of index 0, 3D is not.
status_evidence.claim: Related geometric-analytic properties of the L2 hydrodynamic setup are known, but Palais-Smale of the action remains unaddressed.
